annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously prohibits servers from sending any post‑handshake TLS CertificateRequest messages and requires clients to treat any receipt of such a message as a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION error. The terminology is defined in the referenced TLS 1.3 section, leaving no room for multiple reasonable interpretations.
